about: HO-883: `meta` CLI output shapes the Meta Tasks driver (farm/task_driver_meta.py) reads. farm/tests/test_task_driver_meta.py builds its stubbed Task service from these templates. Only the field names and value formats are real. Every title, text, author and id is made up. Templates marked `captured` copy the shape of read-only calls run on 2026-11-17 (stdout, or stderr for errors). Templates marked `hand-written` are commands that change a Task, which were not run against the live service. Swap them for the owner's scrubbed recordings from a scratch Task. The driver reads only `number`/`url` from a create (falling back to `--external-identifier` lookup), only `id`/`author` from a comment create, and nothing from a close.

error_not_found.provenance: captured (stderr, exit 1): meta tasks.task describe --task=T1 -o json

stderr.message: Task T1 was not found or is not visible to you.

error_user.provenance: captured (stderr, exit 1): meta tasks.task close --outcome=<invalid> -o json, message shortened

stderr.message: Invalid option outcome: zz is not a valid value.
